variables.name: environmentLabel
variables.note: Human-readable environment label (Dev | Prod). Surface in semantic models, notebooks, and reports for visual workspace identification.

variables.name: workspaceId
variables.note: Fabric workspace ID for the active environment. Mirrors the M parameter in Contoso-Sales-Model.SemanticModel/expressions.tmdl for cross-item reference.

variables.name: lakehouseId
variables.note: Contoso_Sales_LH lakehouse item ID in the active workspace.

variables.name: warehouseId
variables.note: Contoso-Sales-WH warehouse item ID in the active workspace.

variables.name: warehouseSqlEndpoint
variables.note: SQL connection string fragment for ad-hoc clients (Power BI Desktop, SSMS) against the active environment's warehouse.
